note: Workflow UI is an OBSOLETE, hidden submodule: the Workflow admin UI is now built into the main 'workflow' module. It ships only an info.yml (hidden: TRUE, depends on workflow, configure: entity.workflow_type.collection) with no routes/forms/config/permissions of its own. Its only live state is whether it is installed, so introspection reads the module registry and execution enables/uninstalls it, verified via \Drupal::moduleHandler()->moduleExists(). Baseline: not installed.

evals.prompt: What is the Workflow UI (workflow_ui) submodule, and do I need to enable it to administer workflows on a current Drupal site?
evals.expected_output: Workflow UI is obsolete and hidden; the admin UI is now incorporated into the main 'workflow' module. You do not need to enable it — manage workflows at /admin/config/workflow/workflow provided by the parent module.

evals.prompt: If Workflow UI is obsolete, where does the actual workflow administration interface come from now, and at what path?
evals.expected_output: The admin UI is provided by the main 'workflow' module at /admin/config/workflow/workflow (route entity.workflow_type.collection, declared in workflow.routing.yml).

evals.prompt: What does the workflow_ui submodule actually ship in its current release, and why is it still present?
evals.expected_output: It ships only an info.yml (marked hidden: TRUE) with no routes/forms/config/permissions. It remains as an empty placeholder for upgrade compatibility with sites that once had it enabled.

evals.prompt: Is the workflow_ui module currently installed/enabled on this Drupal site? Check the running site and answer.
evals.expected_output: Yes — for this check workflow_ui is installed (\Drupal::moduleHandler()->moduleExists('workflow_ui') is TRUE; it shows in drush pm:list, though it is a hidden module).

evals.prompt: The workflow_ui module is enabled on this site. Inspect the running site and state which module it depends on.
evals.expected_output: workflow_ui depends on the main 'workflow' module (info.yml declares dependencies: workflow:workflow).

evals.prompt: For an upgrade-compatibility test, install/enable the (hidden, obsolete) workflow_ui module on this live Drupal site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the module (e.g. drush en workflow_ui -y; it is hidden but installable). Verified by \Drupal::moduleHandler()->moduleExists('workflow_ui') being TRUE.

evals.prompt: The obsolete workflow_ui module is enabled on this site but its functionality is already in the main Workflow module. Uninstall workflow_ui from the live site.
evals.expected_output: Uninstall the module (e.g. drush pmu workflow_ui -y). Verified by \Drupal::moduleHandler()->moduleExists('workflow_ui') being FALSE.
